whole_value_reasoning.composition: The complete command means Return to editing: software allichay is treated as an action nominal with directional -man, followed by intransitive kuti- with singular command -y. Soto directly supplies a nonspatial action-nominal + -man + base kutiy construction, so this is not extrapolated solely from a physical route meaning. A separate work-return example corroborates continuation after interruption, without copying or stripping its person/purpose/inchoative morphology.
whole_value_reasoning.grammar: Fresh official PUCP text identifies its variety as Ayacucho-Chanka and supports infinitival -y as a nominal form, nominal -man as directional, and imperative -y. The PUCP directional rule alone would not establish return-to-activity; Soto supplies that crucial usage. Nominal -y in allichayman and imperative -y in kutiy have distinct syntactic jobs despite identical form.
whole_value_reasoning.intent: Return to the current editing activity preserves the actual Keep editing choice after an interrupting confirmation. It is an intent-preserving adaptation, not a literal proposed suffix for English keep. It does not instruct a new edit, restart the document, select the Edit tab, or repeat a stroke.
whole_value_reasoning.undo_distinction: Intransitive kutiy is not causative kutichiy, which the software guide uses for Undo. No reversal, rollback, restoration of an earlier state, or undoing applyPending is expressed.
whole_value_reasoning.completeness: Both activity destination and return command are present. No placeholder, period, protection guarantee, saved-state assertion, or unstated destructive action is introduced.
